title: Discovery Source Expansion Protocol
objective: Increase opportunity recall by widening and auditing the public-information discovery universe while leaving V1.9 promotion, valuation, timing, quality and adversarial gates unchanged.

selectionPolicy.researchPrinciple: More Primary opportunities must come from discovering more independent economic changes, not from promoting weaker candidates.

coverageRules: Every covered source role must preserve a non-empty searchTrace even when no event is found.
Every frozen source item in schema 2.1 must declare exactly one primary sourceRoleId in addition to its broad lane.
Copies derived from one filing, press release, wire story or anonymous claim remain one originGroup.
Community and regional sources may discover weak signals but cannot replace independent verification.
Cross-border value chains must search overseas first-party or official evidence when it is closer to the physical event.
A source role may be unavailable, but the limitation must be explicit; unavailable roles do not count toward coverage.

evaluation.acceptanceRule: Adopt source expansion only if untouched replay shows materially higher discovery recall and/or independent opportunity frequency without material degradation of Primary quality.
